component.name: Proxbase
component.summary: Proxmox VE clusters in QEMU/KVM for labs and CI

description.p: Proxbase creates real Proxmox VE clusters on a Linux machine in a few minutes. It starts every node as a QEMU/KVM virtual machine, installs it from the official Proxmox VE ISO with the automated installer and joins the nodes into a cluster, with ZFS or Ceph storage, internal networks and an API token ready for Terraform or Ansible.

ul.li: No root and no Docker: only KVM access and qemu-img
ZFS pools or hyperconverged Ceph, several internal networks with VLANs
Start, stop, add and remove nodes, snapshots and resets of the whole cluster
Fault injection: power loss, hung nodes, pulled cables, partitions, latency
JSON output, a GitHub Action and an MCP server for CI and AI agents
